tail: Let there arise salvation from heaven, mercy and kindness, compassion, long life, abundant sustenance, divine help, bodily health, heavenly enlightenment, living and enduring seed who do not interrupt or abandon study of the words of the Torah, to the masters and teachers, the holy congregations in the Land of Israel and in Babylon, the heads of the learned gathering, the Exilarchs, the heads of the academies and the judges at the gate, to all their pupils and all the pupils of their pupils and all who occupy themselves with the Law. May the King of the world bless them, prolong their lives, i

ncrease their days and give length to their years. May they be saved and delivered from every need and all evil happenings. May our Lord in Heaven aid them at every time and season, and let us say: Amen.
